name: form
title: Form (react-hook-form wrapper)
description: The classic shadcn react-hook-form wrapper (Form, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage). The upstream registry retired this item (its modern replacement is Field); Blocks ships it for apps built on the react-hook-form pattern.
docs: Compose Form + FormField/FormItem/FormLabel/FormControl/FormMessage around react-hook-form's useForm. For NEW forms prefer the field component family per the shadcn skill; this item exists for compatibility with the react-hook-form pattern.

changelog.description: Brings the app's copy up to date and adds its version line.
